source.document: Rockchip RK3568 Hardware Design Guide EN V1.2, 2022-01-26

reference_reconciliation: HW Guide recommends more than 200mA capacity for PLL supplies generally. The Rockchip tablet RK809-5 power diagram explicitly uses its 100mA low-noise LDO3 for PMUPLL 0.9V plus PMU logic. This capture follows that exact PMIC reference with a documented 60mA peak sum, not the generic capacity recommendation. PSRR/ripple and hot transient behavior require physical verification.

usb_filter.note: After-test DCR is specified at standard measurement conditions; it is not a guaranteed hot operating resistance. Hot voltage drop, filter resonance and ripple remain physical checks.
